h1: Retro Pod Hire with Classic Photo-Strip Prints
tagline: A DSLR pod with the printer built in: classic photo strips for every guest, minimal cables and a 1.5 metre footprint.
intro: The Retro Pod pairs a DSLR camera with an inbuilt printer in one tidy upright unit, so there are no trailing cables and nothing to trip over. Classic photo-strip prints for every guest, a guest book to collect them in, and a footprint of just 1.5 metres square.

sections.heading: A booth built around the printer
paragraphs: Most open-air pods keep the printer in a separate case on the floor, which means a cable run, a table and a bit of mess. The Retro Pod puts the printer inside the column itself, so the whole booth is a single upright unit about 1.9 metres tall and half a metre square. A DSLR camera sits at eye level behind the front panel, with LED lighting built around it.

A session starts when a guest touches the screen. The pod runs a countdown, fires a sequence of shots and lays them out as a classic vertical photo strip, the kind you would have collected from a seaside booth years ago, but with a sharper image and a template designed for your event. The strips print from the slot in the pod, one for each person in the group, and the attendant hands them round.

sections.heading: The footprint: 1.5m by 1.5m and one socket
paragraphs: Because the printer lives inside the column, the Retro Pod needs less floor space than almost anything else we hire: a clear 1.5 metre by 1.5 metre area is enough for the pod and a small group in front of it. The unit measures approximately 1.9m high by 0.5m wide by 0.5m deep. Power comes from one standard socket, and there is no cabling across the floor apart from the single lead to the wall.

That tidy footprint suits venues where space is tight: a narrow hotel function room, a converted barn with pillars, a village hall with a stage taking up one end. Put it where there is a plain wall or room for a backdrop behind the guests, and ideally where the attendant can stand to one side without blocking a thoroughfare. The pod travels in cases and goes up stairs without trouble.

sections.heading: Six per shot, one strip each
paragraphs: The camera comfortably frames up to six guests, which keeps the strips readable; more than that and faces get small on a strip format. Each session takes about a minute including the print, so a steady hour sees around forty groups through. With a print for everyone in the shot, a group of four leaves with four strips, and the guest book gets its own copy from the attendant.

If you have a large guest list, the quick turnaround helps, and because sessions are unlimited guests often come back later in the night for a second go with different props. The attendant keeps the props tidy between groups and reloads the printer paper before it runs low, so the pace stays steady from the first guest to the last.

sections.heading: Photo strips, USB and email
paragraphs: The strip format is the reason people choose this pod. Each strip carries a column of frames with your names, the date or a logo printed along the bottom, and the attendant can print extras for the guest book. Prints are ready moments after the final frame, and there is no separate printer to walk to.

All photos from the night are copied to a USB stick for you to keep, and guests can email individual strips to themselves from the pod. Digital copies are included as standard so nothing is lost if a strip goes astray on the dance floor.

sections.heading: Styling the strips and the pod
paragraphs: We design the strip template to match your invitations, table plan or brand guidelines, with colours, fonts and a logo or monogram where you want them. Vintage black and white or full colour are both available. The start screen can carry the same artwork, and a backdrop in your colours completes the look. Green screen backgrounds are available on request.

sections.heading: Included as standard
paragraphs: The Retro Pod comes with a professional attendant who stays for the whole hire, free delivery, setup and pack-down, unlimited sessions, a guest book, props, LED lighting, the custom template, the USB and email sharing. Public liability insurance covers every booking, and venues can have a copy of the certificate on request.

sections.heading: Events, prices and how to book
paragraphs: The retro look suits weddings with a vintage or rustic theme, birthday parties, proms and corporate socials where guests want something to pin on a noticeboard. Asian weddings with big family groups appreciate the fast print turnaround and the small amount of floor the pod takes from the room.

Retro Pod hire starts from £299, with an £80 deposit to secure the date and the balance due one month before. Tell us the date and venue and we will confirm availability within 24 hours. Our team arrives 45 to 60 minutes before the hire starts to set up, and that time is free of charge. faqs.q: Why does the inbuilt printer matter?
faqs.a: It removes the separate printer case, the table it sits on and the cable between the two. The result is a single upright pod with one lead to the wall, which is tidier, safer in a busy room and quicker to set up. It also means the pod fits in a 1.5 metre square where other booths cannot.

faqs.q: How many prints come out of each session?
faqs.a: One photo strip for every guest in the shot, up to six per session. The attendant adds a further strip to the guest book so you keep a copy of every group. Sessions are unlimited during the hire, so guests can return as many times as they like.

faqs.q: Can the Retro Pod be used outside?
faqs.a: Only in a marquee or other covered area with a standard plug socket nearby. The DSLR, screen and inbuilt printer are not weatherproof, and the screen is hard to see in direct sunlight. A marquee reception with power is fine; an open lawn is not.

faqs.q: Will it fit through a standard door or up stairs?
faqs.a: Yes. The pod is about half a metre wide and travels in protective cases, so it passes through ordinary doorways and up a staircase without trouble. Let us know in advance if the room is on an upper floor with no lift so the attendant can plan the carry.

faqs.q: Do we get digital copies of the strips?
faqs.a: Yes. Every photo is saved and handed over on a USB stick at the end of the night, and guests can email strips to themselves from the pod during the event. The digital set is included in the package at no extra cost.

The attendant arrives 45 to 60 minutes before your hire window to position the pod, backdrop and props and test the printer. Because the printer is built in, setup is one of the quickest of our booths, and the time is never charged to you.
